name: Bursa Malaysia
note: 2010-2024 sourced from exchange_calendars only (backfill; not independently verified): 228 closures (77 with exchange_calendars' names) and 19 half days at 12:30 (morning session only, on the eves of Chinese New Year and Hari Raya, 2010-2024; exchange_calendars' value, the end of Trading at Last). Bursa's own half-day notices (e.g. Chinese New Year 2015, https://www.bursamalaysia.com/sites/5bb54be15f36ca0af339077a/assets/5bb55aa65f36ca0c3028d89b/Closure_of_The_Exchange_for_Chinese_New_Year.pdf) give the morning session with Pre-Closing 12:15, Closing 12:20 and Trading At Last 12:20-12:30, so ADR 0013 would give 12:20; the backfill keeps 12:30 (a convention difference, like the XETR and XWBO backfills). 2025-2026: exchange_calendars + exchange_publications. 2027: predicted from the Cabinet's 2027 public-holiday schedule (Cabinet, Constitution and Inter-Governmental Relations Division, 27 August 2026, as circulated by FMM, https://www.fmm.org.my/uploads/files/fmm/20260828_144306_GI15%20-%202027%20Public%20Holiday%20National%20&%20State%20-%2027%20Aug.pdf): Chinese New Year 6-7 February (weekend, so 8-9 February in lieu), Hari Raya Puasa 10-11 March (subject to change), Prophet Muhammad's Birthday Sunday 15 August (16 August in lieu); the registry matches it. Bursa's own 2027 closures are not published (4d.1). 2028-2029: standing pattern; the Islamic-calendar holidays are estimates until gazetted. Checked 2026-11-20 (4c9). Last published year: Bursa's market-holidays page (bursamalaysia.com/market_information/market_holidays) refuses this sandbox, so 2027 was not compared against it. Half days now: the registry has none for 2025-2029, and Bursa's media notification of 18 March 2026 (https://www.bursamalaysia.com/sites/5bb54be15f36ca0af339077a/content_entry5c11a9db758f8d31544574c6/69ba6ea5e6414a853f606e2c/files/180326_MEDIA_NOTIFICATION_CLOSURE_OF_BURSA_MALAYSIA_IN_CONJUNCTION_WITH_HARI_RAYA_AIDILFITRI_PUBLIC_HOLIDAY.pdf) says both markets operated under normal trading hours on 19 March 2026, the eve of Hari Raya Aidilfitri, and that Bursa closed on 20 and 23 March 2026 (both in the file; they now cite it). Close (ADR 0013): Bursa's equities trading-sessions page (https://www.bursamalaysia.com/trade/trading_resources/equities/trading_sessions, read only as a search snippet; the page refuses this sandbox) gives the 2nd session as Pre-Closing 4:45pm, Closing 4:50pm and Trading at Last 4:50-5:00pm; the PO Trading Manual says the last Theoretical Closing Price calculated in Pre-Closing is the closing price. The close is therefore 16:50 (was 17:00, the end of Trading at Last; exchange_calendars has 17:00), as one dated entry from 2010-01-01 (unconfirmed: the 2nd-session timing has been 4:45/4:50/5:00 since at least 26 October 2009 per Bursa's announcement then, but that was read only through a republication). post_market and extended_hours.after_hours now open at 16:50 (Trading at Last 16:50-17:00) and keep their 17:15 end (the trading manual's end of market day for one segment). The lunch break (12:30-14:30, with the 2nd-session pre-opening from 14:00) is unchanged. 4c10 re-read attempt: Bursa's trading-sessions page and trading manual still refuse this sandbox, and searches return only broker republications of the same schedule (Pre-Closing 4:45pm, Closing 4:50pm, Trading at Last 4:50-5:00pm), which are not Bursa's own documents. The 16:50 close is therefore kept as the ADR 0013 value but unconfirmed: its only regular_hours entry (effective 2010-01-01) stays in the 2010-2024 span's unconfirmed list, and this note records that it was never read from Bursa's own page.

Open 09:00; close 16:50, the Closing after the 16:45 Pre-Closing (ADR 0013); Trading at Last is not regular hours; the 12:30-14:30 break is a lunch break, out of scope. 4c9 took 16:50 from a search snippet of this page; this is the page itself. verified_from 2026-11-22: the page states no effective date (the print's date).
